import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

off=[o for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.name.startswith('OFICIAL |')]
assert off, 'Objetos OFICIAL ausentes'
base=bpy.data.objects.get('OFICIAL | Entrada superior | lintel')
assert base, 'Lintel oficial ausente'
theta=base.rotation_euler.z
ex=Vector((math.cos(theta),math.sin(theta),0.0))
ey=Vector((-math.sin(theta),math.cos(theta),0.0))
origin=Vector((base.location.x,base.location.y,0.0))

def proj_bounds(o):
    pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
    us=[(p-origin).dot(ex) for p in pts]
    vs=[(p-origin).dot(ey) for p in pts]
    zs=[p.z for p in pts]
    return min(us),max(us),min(vs),max(vs),min(zs),max(zs)

print('GEOMETRY_AXIS_AUDIT')
print(f'THETA_DEG={math.degrees(theta):.6f}')
print('PASSARELA_OBJECTS')
for o in sorted([x for x in off if 'passarela' in x.name.lower()], key=lambda x:x.name):
    u0,u1,v0,v1,z0,z1=proj_bounds(o)
    print(f'{o.name}|U=[{u0:.4f},{u1:.4f}] L={u1-u0:.4f}|V=[{v0:.4f},{v1:.4f}] W={v1-v0:.4f}|Z=[{z0:.4f},{z1:.4f}] H={z1-z0:.4f}|DIMS={tuple(round(float(v),4) for v in o.dimensions)}')

print('TOWER_OBJECTS')
for o in sorted([x for x in off if 'torre' in x.name.lower()], key=lambda x:x.name):
    u0,u1,v0,v1,z0,z1=proj_bounds(o)
    print(f'{o.name}|U=[{u0:.4f},{u1:.4f}]|V=[{v0:.4f},{v1:.4f}]|Z=[{z0:.4f},{z1:.4f}] H={z1-z0:.4f}|DIMS={tuple(round(float(v),4) for v in o.dimensions)}')

print('TERMINAL_OBJECTS')
for o in sorted([x for x in off if ('terminal alto' in x.name.lower() or 'entrada superior' in x.name.lower())], key=lambda x:x.name):
    u0,u1,v0,v1,z0,z1=proj_bounds(o)
    print(f'{o.name}|U=[{u0:.4f},{u1:.4f}] L={u1-u0:.4f}|V=[{v0:.4f},{v1:.4f}] W={v1-v0:.4f}|Z=[{z0:.4f},{z1:.4f}]')

# union longitudinal da passarela
po=[x for x in off if 'passarela' in x.name.lower()]
pts=[]
for o in po: pts += [o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
us=[(p-origin).dot(ex) for p in pts]; vs=[(p-origin).dot(ey) for p in pts]; zs=[p.z for p in pts]
print(f'PASSARELA_UNION_U=[{min(us):.4f},{max(us):.4f}] L={max(us)-min(us):.4f}')
print(f'PASSARELA_UNION_V=[{min(vs):.4f},{max(vs):.4f}] W={max(vs)-min(vs):.4f}')
print(f'PASSARELA_UNION_Z=[{min(zs):.4f},{max(zs):.4f}] H={max(zs)-min(zs):.4f}')
